title: Crop Disease — Model Performance
description: Live model behaviour on replayed real Sentinel-2 sequences (agreement with their CDM labels, confidence, out-of-distribution rate) and the offline evaluation published by run_pipeline.py (CDM + Sentinel-2, weak labels).

list.name: station
list.label: Station
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "${bucket}", tag: "station_id", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "spectral_readings", start: -30d)
list.definition:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "${bucket}", tag: "station_id", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "spectral_readings", start: -30d)

list.name: source
list.label: Source
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "${bucket}", tag: "source", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "spectral_readings", start: -30d)
list.definition:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "${bucket}", tag: "source", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "spectral_readings", start: -30d)

list.name: run_id
list.label: Pipeline run
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "${bucket}", tag: "run_id", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "pipeline_run", start: -3650d)
list.definition:

panels.title: Rolling agreement with ground truth (last 20 predictions)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "disease_predictions")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "correct")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.station_id =~ /^${station:regex}$/ and r.source =~ /^${source:regex}$/)
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> movingAverage(n: 20)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

panels.title: Live confusion matrix (rows = true profile)
panels.description: Counts of live predictions by CDM label of the replayed sequence (row) and model output (column)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "disease_predictions")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "label_name")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.station_id =~ /^${station:regex}$/ and r.source =~ /^${source:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.true_profile)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with predicted: r._value}))
  |> group(columns: ["true_profile", "predicted"])
  |> count()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["true_profile"], columnKey: ["predicted"], valueColumn: "_value")

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "disease_predictions")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "confidence")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.station_id =~ /^${station:regex}$/ and r.source =~ /^${source:regex}$/)
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "disease_predictions")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "confidence" or r._field == "risk_score")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.station_id =~ /^${station:regex}$/ and r.source =~ /^${source:regex}$/)
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.title: Test accuracy and macro-F1 by model

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -3650d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "model_evaluation")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "accuracy" or r._field == "f1_macro")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.run_id == "${run_id}")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["model"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["model", "accuracy", "f1_macro"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -3650d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "model_significance")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "p_value" or r._field == "only_a_correct" or r._field == "only_b_correct" or r._field == "significant")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.run_id == "${run_id}")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["model_a", "model_b"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["model_a", "model_b", "only_a_correct", "only_b_correct", "p_value", "significant"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -3650d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "model_evaluation")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "accuracy" or r._field == "accuracy_ci_low" or r._field == "accuracy_ci_high" or r._field == "f1_macro" or r._field == "f1_macro_ci_low" or r._field == "f1_macro_ci_high" or r._field == "f1_early_stress")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.run_id == "${run_id}")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["model"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["model", "accuracy", "accuracy_ci_low", "accuracy_ci_high", "f1_macro", "f1_macro_ci_low", "f1_macro_ci_high", "f1_early_stress"])

panels.title: Training loss by epoch
panels.description: Per-epoch training and validation loss of each sequence model

targets.query:
data = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -3650d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "training_history")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "epoch" or r._field == "train_loss" or r._field == "val_loss")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.run_id == "${run_id}")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "model"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
s0 = data |> map(fn: (r) => ({epoch: r.epoch, series: r.model + " train", value: r.train_loss}))
s1 = data |> map(fn: (r) => ({epoch: r.epoch, series: r.model + " validation", value: r.val_loss}))
union(tables: [s0, s1])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["epoch"], columnKey: ["series"], valueColumn: "value")
  |> sort(columns: ["epoch"])

panels.title: Validation macro-F1 by epoch
panels.description: Checkpoints are chosen at the epoch with the best validation macro-F1

targets.query:
data = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -3650d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "training_history")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "epoch" or r._field == "val_macro_f1" or r._field == "train_acc")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.run_id == "${run_id}")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "model"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
s0 = data |> map(fn: (r) => ({epoch: r.epoch, series: r.model + " val macro-F1", value: r.val_macro_f1}))
s1 = data |> map(fn: (r) => ({epoch: r.epoch, series: r.model + " train accuracy", value: r.train_acc}))
union(tables: [s0, s1])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["epoch"], columnKey: ["series"], valueColumn: "value")
  |> sort(columns: ["epoch"])

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.run_id == "${run_id}")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["model"], columnKey: ["cv_split"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -3650d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "feature_selection")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "cv_f1_macro_mean" or r._field == "test_f1_macro")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.run_id == "${run_id}")

  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["method", "cv_f1_macro_mean", "test_f1_macro"])

panels.title: Batch risk map — every sample, best model
panels.description: Pipeline predictions for all samples (train/val/test) at the real CDM report sites. Labels are time-relative, so a site colour shows where its sequences fall in the outbreak timeline.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -3650d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "batch_risk")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "latitude" or r._field == "longitude" or r._field == "risk_score" or r._field == "predicted_label" or r._field == "true_label" or r._field == "sample_id")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.run_id == "${run_id}")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "split"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
